stature.basis: Lossing, who met him about 1848, gives him "about five feet ten inches" with "an expansive chest and broad shoulders" — a measure of his old age, taken here for 1812.

basis: His complexion (light), hair (brown) and eyes (dark) are drawn in the register's own words from what the Register of Enlistments wrote of 199 men of the 22nd US Infantry, 1812-14; his own entry has not been read. The short crop is our choice for a soldier of the time.
